_comment: Manual status overrides. Status is normally DERIVED from git — merged to
develop = done, open PR = in-review, pushed branch = in-progress. Use this
file only when reality and git genuinely disagree.
Every override needs a reason. An override without one is how a plan starts
reporting what people wish were true.
Valid status values: todo | in-progress | in-review | done | blocked

A-001.reason: Maven multi-module skeleton (common/domain/api/worker) builds green; landed before the task-ID commit convention

A-002.reason: docker-compose.yml verified running MySQL 8.4 + Redis + MinIO + Mailpit; predates the task-ID commit convention

Supersedes the earlier hand-verification; commit subject said 'A011' without the hyphen

D-053.reason: Debashis — git reads this as done, and the backlog entry says otherwise in its own first line. **Corrected 20 Aug: search and emoji are shipped; file share is the one half left.** Emoji landed once D-065 built the chat composer, which is what it was actually waiting on — it needed no backend at all: chat_messages.body is utf8mb4 (checked against the live column), nothing sanitises the body, and the mention parser reads @handle rather than scanning code points. File/image share still has nowhere to put the row: ticket_attachments.ticket_id is NOT NULL, so an attachment on a DM or project channel is unrepresentable, and there is no chat_attachments table. PostMessage.attachmentIds is on the contract and on the DTO and is accepted and silently ignored. Two shapes are possible — a chat_message_attachments join, or ticket_attachments.ticket_id made nullable with a chat_message_id beside it — and both are Stream C's table and Stream C's upload pipeline (C-024/C-025 own MinIO keys, MIME sniffing and AV scan); a second pipeline here would put two answers next to each other for 'is this file safe'. Needs Divyansh's sign-off on the table shape.

D-037.reason: Debashis — git reads this as done off the merge of branch feat/engines/d-037-mail-events, and the branch was named for the task while carrying only D-030's mail body and one of the fifteen events. **Corrected 19 Aug: 9 of §4B.6's 15 rows now have a producer, not 5.** The previous wording said eight had nowhere to fire from because C-038, C-040, C-042, C-044 and C-049 were unbuilt — three of those have since landed and nobody re-read the note, which is the failure mode an override has when it is written once and quoted afterwards. TicketEventNotifier wires the four whose trigger now exists: created-and-assigned (TicketWriteService, C-067), comment added (CommentService, C-029), closed (CloseService, C-040) and reopened (ReopenService, C-038). Live already elsewhere: level raised to Critical, SLA breach, stage SLA breach, @mention and status requested. **4 still have no trigger** — handoff, sent back for rework and deployment done all fire from C-045's transition, which is in review, and reassigned-within-a-stage is C-049, unstarted. The remaining 2 rows are the digests and belong to D-038, which is done. The engine itself was finished long ago — enqueue, render, thread, retry, rate limit and the preference lock — so what is left is four call sites in code somebody else has not written yet

A-030.reason: Shivendra, PR #87 merged 2026-08-11 — features/auth/ with LoginPage, ForgotPassword, ResetPassword, ChangePassword, authStore, RequireAuth and the strength meter, verified against the real stack (MySQL, Redis, packaged jar, Vite proxy with VITE_USE_MOCKS=false), and checked off in STREAM-A-PLATFORM.md. Commit subject carried no task ID and the merge subject only had the lowercase branch slug 'a-030', which the [A-D]-\d{3} pattern does not match
